scope: Teacher Q1–Q3/E0–E4 backend evidence, diagnosis, practice and lesson-interaction regression
environment: Compiled real Teacher domain and PostgreSQL16 disposable Docker; synthetic generation port only

defects.before: Reader block tools requested learning history after the material had rendered, adding a request and temporary per-block skeleton whose replacement shifted the layout in the Client laboratory.
defects.after: The material response includes lesson_interactions for the exact content version in one bounded query, ordered by created_at DESC and id DESC with LIMIT40, with ISO timestamps. Client consumes this admitted history without a learning request per block. The backend regression checks version isolation and ownership; actual layout and network savings belong to the Client performance campaign.

defects.before: A new prediction/check accepted a superseded or other-plan content version and a kind different from its actual block, provided the session and block ID existed.
defects.after: A new interaction requires the current accepted plan, current content publication and exact block kind. Existing history remains readable under its original version; no response is migrated.

defects.before: The generative lesson-interaction query omitted created_at, losing temporal provenance in the admitted snapshot.
defects.after: The query selects created_at and normalizes it to ISO before canonical prompt/hash serialization. The SQL regression checks the actual timestamp survives canonicalization.

defects.before: A newly published unit-practice assessment could reuse an already answered task with another item ID and report its correct response as independent application.
defects.after: At attempt admission, same-owner prior submitted tasks are matched by item fingerprint or prompt variant group. The new response records previously_seen_item and the prior response ID; the attempt is assisted. A later genuinely distinct occurrence can retain independence. Original observations and scores are not rewritten.

defects.before: Refreshing128 eligible responses made one SELECT plus128 individual INSERT statements inside the authority transaction.
defects.after: One bounded INSERT SELECT preserves the128-row cap, exact source fields and unique grading-event key; duplicate refreshes do not create events again.

defects.before: Generation selected the global last100 observations and filtered revision/unit afterward.100 newer unrelated observations could hide valid evidence for the requested unit and produce insufficient_evidence.
defects.after: Generation filters exact revision or explicit mapping and the requested unit's objectives before the100-observation cap. The public historical projection is unchanged.112 newer observations from another objective no longer displace target evidence.

verification.command: npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json; npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json

guarantees: Diagnostic pause/resume preserves answer, confidence zero, self-explanation, cursor and recovered receipt without inference. Correct exact answer remains2points despite an incoherent self-explanation; authored diagnosis remains assisted.

Mappings reject another session and nonexistent objective; an unchanged objective ID in another plan revision does not carry mapping/evidence implicitly. A manual plan can be accepted while an optional diagnostic remains available.

Lesson interactions require exact current version/kind, recover one durable event, race through session CAS, keep history across reload and reject superseded writes; generative timestamps remain ISO. Material projection returns only its exact version's interactions, excludes another unit's history and rejects another owner.
An error, a subsequent assisted success, a repeated known task and a distinct new occurrence have separate immutable provenance; none creates section verification.
Refreshing128 eligible responses uses one SQL statement and is idempotent, with field-for-field output equivalent to the previous implementation.
Target generation retains12 relevant observations and concrete response details even when112 newer unrelated observations fill the historical last100 view.

verification.includes: Self-contained rerun without optional baseline module, including material lesson_interactions contract, exact content-version isolation and owner boundary. Production compile and scoped lint also passed after this additive change.
Frozen generation evidence/hash remains unchanged after a later response; ownership, reviewed bank, private keys, null/zero, CAS and rollback preservation.
Final90 exact, pending not zero, private answers until full submission, archive/pause/cursor, revision/fences, manual acceptance and unknown without replay.

verification.command: git diff --check (owned scope) and fatal UTF-8/LF byte check

comparison.baseline: Compiled previous refresh implementation captured before editing; experiment file ignored, permanent integration runs without this optional baseline dependency
comparison.limitations: Local SQL latency with synthetic rows, no remote-provider time, production load or UI-route performance claim. Query-count reduction is directly observed; educational efficacy is not measured.

criterion_mapping.common_review: Integrated UI/runtime/selection acceptance belongs to root campaign.
Browser reload and two-tab traversal remains a separate UI check.
Real form drafts/errors are checked by UI campaign.
No automatic interpretation or structured misconception is claimed; semantic quality requires reviewed sample.
Provider output use of the evidence belongs to real campaign.
No universal expiration window or automatic contradictory hypothesis is invented.
Client route/bundle/map costs are measured separately.
Pedagogical review and topic validity cannot be inferred from SQL declaration reviewed=true.
The finite manual bank is not a calibrated adaptive probing algorithm or official level assessment.
Semantic interpretation of results remains distinct from observed answers.
Reason usefulness in reviewed real content belongs to root sample.
Mechanics distinguish tasks; no causal transfer efficacy is claimed.
Leaving/choosing saved reading is not graded abandonment; complete navigation is a UI check.
Actual dispatch/reserve/no-replay is checked by root runtime/provider campaign.
Reviewed pedagogical placement and optional UI reading require common sample.
Actual corrective teaching is validated on real material by root.

outside_this_agent_scope: TU-E0-01 and TU-E0-04: final candidate/environment/provider acceptance and consolidated baseline
TU-E2-05, TU-E2-07 and TU-E3-03: real provider contrast/failures and reviewed two-topic teaching/transfer sample
TU-E4-04: frontend route/profile comparison beyond measured SQL refresh
All UI keyboard/screen reader/two-tab and real-provider claims
lab_observation: One initial extended disposable run ended with PostgreSQL connection terminated unexpectedly; no cause established. A fresh isolated run passed all six checks and three comparative pairs; no provider request or operational state was involved or replayed.
